FINITE_CENTRE_ERROR.DERIVATION: for N molecules drawn from a distribution with covariance Sigma, the empirical mean has E||C_hat - C*||^2 = tr(Sigma)/N. On the torus the Frechet centre coincides with the empirical mean while the cloud does not wrap. The centre-free pairwise radius of gyration satisfies Rg^2 = tr(Sigma), so the per-axis error of the centre is sigma = Rg / sqrt(2 N).
FINITE_CENTRE_ERROR.STATUS: EXACT FOR THE EMPIRICAL MEAN OF IID POSITIONS; APPROXIMATE FOR THE FRECHET CENTRE ON A TORUS, AND ONLY WHILE THE CLOUD DOES NOT WRAP. It is NOT claimed exact: the numerical checks below are what support it.
ADDITIONAL_TERMS_NOT_MODELLED: temporal autocorrelation: successive frames are not independent, so the effective N over a window is not the number of molecules times the number of frames
multimodality: with several components the Frechet centre is not near any of them
the halo: the outer mass has larger leverage on the centre than the core
lattice rounding of the centre, worth 1/12 per axis
toroidal wrap, which breaks the mean-centre correspondence entirely
FINITE_CENTRE_ERROR.READING: at the typical population N = 121 the centre error inflates the measured offset by 0.7 %; at N = 10 by 9.4 %; at N = 5 by 19.7 %. The metric therefore rises when the population falls, with no change whatever in the underlying attachment.

SYNTHETIC_ASSAY.NOTE: the assay contains no domain effect by construction: the same law is used at every L. The control shows the residual spread between sizes at fixed N, which is the assay's own noise floor.

DOWNSAMPLING.NOTE: diagnostic only; the real geometry and the real source are preserved and only the molecule count is reduced
DOWNSAMPLING.AGGREGATION_NOTE: the per-arm ratio is undefined when the full-sample offset is near zero, so the aggregate is reported as the RATIO OF MEANS, with the median per-arm ratio restricted to arms whose full-sample offset exceeds half a cell as a companion

POPULATION_NULL.NOTE: the latent offset is IDENTICAL at every L by construction. Only the observed population distributions differ between sizes. Any beta produced here is pure measurement artefact.

GUARD_RAIL_CONFOUND_CHECK.READING: the confound is specific to |C-Y|. The guard-rail statistics are within-cloud quantities that do not involve Y and are far less sensitive to the molecule count: corr(log N_X, log Rg) = -0.600 and corr(log N_X, log r80) = -0.587 against -0.846 for the primary metric.
